remarks: Welcome to 27 Lund Avenue, a 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod set in a quiet neighborhood in Newfield. Step inside to 1,376 square feet of comfortable living space starting with the bright living room, anchored by a wood-burning fireplace and hardwood floors. It flows naturally into the large eat in kitchen into the home's standout feature -- a 3-season enclosed porch perfect for morning coffee or evening entertaining. The first floor offers a third bedroom or office, a dining room (or fourth bedroom), and a half-bath recently refreshed, while upstairs you'll find two bedrooms and a full bathroom completely renovated in 2024. A 2025 hot water heater and central air throughout the home keep systems running smoothly. The partially finished basement provides laundry and storage, with a one-car garage tucked underneath. Outside, an exceptional fenced yard offers space for pets or entertaining for barbecues and summer fun with a fire pit for cozy nights. Location delivers here -- you're minutes from downtown Stamford, the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North stations, Hope Street and High Ridge Road shopping including Trader Joe's and Starbucks, yet tucked into a peaceful neighborhood. Schools are very close, and Sterling Farms Golf Course and Davenport Ridge Park are just down the road. Built in 1940, this home balances classic charm with modern updates in one of Stamford's most accessible neighborhoods
